query: How can I renew my Re-Entry Permit (REP) if I am residing/working overseas?
reference_answer: Applicants with valid Singpass account can submit your applications for REP facilities using ICA e-Service while overseas.If you do not have a Singpass account, you can submit your application through our Singapore Missions overseas. Please note that overseas application must be submitted at least two months before the expiry of the current REP.
answer: To renew a Re-Entry Permit (REP) while overseas, you need to apply for an Extension of REP (E-REP). This can be done through the U.S. Embassy or Consulate in your country of residence. Ensure you have all required documents ready, including proof of U.S. residency and financial stability. [Document 1]
